layout.hierarchy: Flowchart boxes dominate visually; process boxes are horizontally centered in upper-middle, diamonds branch below; slide number is small but high-contrast in corner

visual_elements.description: Vertical flowchart: top purple rectangle 'Initialization (Random Weights)' with arrow down to light green rectangle 'Pick Training Sample, and Corresponding Label'; arrow down to light yellow rectangle 'Go Forward, Calculate Output'; arrow down to light yellow rectangle 'Go Backward, Update weights'; arrow down to orange diamond 'Last Sample ?'. From 'Last Sample ?': blue 'Yes' arrow down to orange diamond 'Stop criteria is reached'; red 'NO' arrow curves right and up back to 'Pick Training Sample'. From 'Stop criteria is reached': blue 'Yes' arrow right to bright green rectangle 'Stop'; red 'NO' arrow left to orange diamond 'Max Iteration Is reached'. From 'Max Iteration Is reached': blue 'Yes' arrow down to pink/red rectangle 'Stop with FAIL'; red 'NO' arrow left to purple rectangle 'Pick First Sample again'. A large curved arrow on the left side points right into 'Go Forward, Calculate Output'.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Box text is black, bold, centered. Connector labels 'Yes' are blue, 'NO' are red. Slide number '23' is black text inside yellow circle.
animation_state: No animation visible; all flowchart elements appear static and fully revealed.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a blank PowerPoint slide with white background. 2. Add a thick maroon rectangular border (#8B0000) around the slide content area. 3. Insert a yellow circle (#FFD700) with black outline in the top-right corner containing the number '23' in black. 4. Add a purple rounded rectangle (#DDA0DD) at top center with text 'Initialization (Random Weights)' in black bold sans-serif. 5. Below it, add a light green rounded rectangle (#90EE90) with text 'Pick Training Sample, and Corresponding Label'. 6. Below that, add a light yellow rounded rectangle (#FFFFE0) with text 'Go Forward, Calculate Output'. 7. Below that, add another light yellow rounded rectangle (#FFFFE0) with text 'Go Backward, Update weights'. 8. Below that, add an orange diamond (#F4A460) with text 'Last Sample ?'. 9. From 'Last Sample ?', draw a blue arrow down labeled 'Yes' to an orange diamond 'Stop criteria is reached'. 10. From 'Last Sample ?', draw a red curved arrow labeled 'NO' looping back up to 'Pick Training Sample'. 11. From 'Stop criteria is reached', draw a blue arrow right labeled 'Yes' to a bright green rectangle (#00FF00) with text 'Stop'. 12. From 'Stop criteria is reached', draw a red arrow left labeled 'NO' to an orange diamond 'Max Iteration Is reached'. 13. From 'Max Iteration Is reached', draw a blue arrow down labeled 'Yes' to a pink rectangle (#FFB6C1) with text 'Stop with FAIL'. 14. From 'Max Iteration Is reached', draw a red arrow left labeled 'NO' to a purple rectangle (#DDA0DD) with text 'Pick First Sample again'. 15. Add a large curved arrow on the left side pointing right into 'Go Forward, Calculate Output'. 16. Ensure all connector labels 'Yes' are blue and 'NO' are red.
